content.value_statement: AI answers can miss requirements, assumptions, or quality issues. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured review process.
actual_capabilities: Maps user requests to delivered outputs and identifies uncovered requirements.
Scores correctness, completeness, clarity, efficiency, security, and usability.
Finds missing edge cases, weak explanations, and unclear next steps.
Provides quality report templates for consistent response reviews.
Includes Python scripts for completeness, security, and code quality checks of response text.
limitations: The skill does not verify facts against live sources by itself.
Script results are heuristic and need human review.
Quality scores depend on the prompt, requirements, and available context.
The skill can miss domain errors that are not visible in the response.

use_cases.title: Review Complex AI Answers
use_cases.description: Check whether a long answer covered every requirement and gave useful next steps.

use_cases.title: Audit Code Responses
use_cases.description: Evaluate generated code answers for security, error handling, tests, and maintainability.

use_cases.title: Improve Support Content
use_cases.description: Find unclear explanations, missing context, and gaps in user-facing guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Answer
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this answer for correctness, completeness, and clarity. List the three most important improvements first.

prompt_templates.title: Compare To Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the response against these requirements. Mark each requirement as covered, partial, or missing, then suggest fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Code Response
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this code answer across security, error handling, edge cases, tests, and maintainability. Prioritize risks by user impact.

prompt_templates.title: Track Recurring Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze several responses from the same workflow. Identify recurring gaps, likely causes, and a practical improvement plan.

output_examples.input: A generated answer that explains a database migration plan.
output_examples.output: Quality review with requirement coverage, missing rollback guidance, security notes, and prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: A code response with a missing error path.
output_examples.output: Report flags missing error handling, notes the affected user flow, and recommends validation plus tests.

best_practices: Review the original request before scoring the response.
Separate factual errors, missing requirements, and style issues.
Give fixes that are specific enough to apply immediately.
anti_patterns: Do not score a response without comparing it to the user request.
Do not treat a polished explanation as proof that the answer is correct.
Do not ignore security or error handling when code is included.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews correctness, completeness, clarity, efficiency, security, and usability of AI responses.

faq.question: Can it check code answers?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance and scripts for code quality, security patterns, and completeness checks.

faq.question: Does it replace human review?
faq.answer: No. It gives structured evidence and scores, but humans should confirm important decisions.

faq.question: Does it run live fact checking?
faq.answer: No. It does not browse or verify changing facts unless the host agent uses other tools.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill is described for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: How should I use the scores?
faq.answer: Use scores to prioritize fixes, then read the issue notes for concrete changes.
